poem_stanzas:
I am the road that walks without feet
I am born in hills where small streams meet
I carve the land with patient art
I carry mountains in my heart

Dams may hold me, bridges span my face
Boats ride my back from place to place
I feed the fields and quench the town
I meet the sea and lay my burden down
ciphers.hint: The flowing road that seeks the sea.
